sources_tried: Seed file research/installers/raw/seeds/nashville.json: WORKED. It had 42 maps results and 17 web results. The web results were google.com/goto redirects with no domains, so I couldn't use them. I opened the plausible maps sites: Pillar Door, Soran Group and Southeast Partitions worked. Manning Materials returned 500 and Fast Partitions returned 403. The rest were remodelers, glass shops, plumbers and stores.

Scranton Products where-to-buy (scrantonproducts.com/where-to-buy/): WORKED. The only rep for TN is Southern States Architectural Sales (678.425.8796, AL/GA/FL/MS/NC/SC/TN), a rep agency, not an installer.
Bobrick find-a-rep: page loads, but finding a rep needs the dropdown, so I couldn't read any results.
Bradley find-a-rep: page content was empty.
Hadrian /where-to-buy, ASI asi-accuratepartitions.com/find-a-rep and Metpar /representatives: all returned 404.
General Partitions and Ampco/Ammco locators: not tried.
The Blue Book (thebluebook.com): BLOCKED (403 on search and iProView pages). No Nashville Blue Book profiles showed up in search.

Procore network: WORKED. The Nashville category page and profiles opened, but the category list was mostly unrelated trades. It surfaced Himmel's Mt. Juliet; The Install Group (Brentwood) is a GC with no partition work.

BBB category page https://www.bbb.org/us/tn/category/partition: WORKED. It surfaced Commercial Installation LLC, Manning Materials, One Point Partitions, Fast Partitions and Southeast Partitions. Prestige and JM Specialties are in Chattanooga, outside the radius, so I left them out.
Gallatin Chamber member pages (members.gallatintn.org): WORKED, for Fast Partitions.
Bing search via WebFetch: no relevant results.

WebSearch: used all 8 of 8 allowed searches. They covered the Nashville toilet partition and Division 10 queries, suburb-name queries, Blue Book Nashville, toilet compartments subcontractor, the restroom partitions installer TN cities query, the specialties/lockers query, the Division 10 furnish-and-install query, and Division X Specialties Franklin. They found Allegheny Construction Specialties and confirmed Pillar Door's Division 10 page.

Skipped: Restroom Stalls and All (Gainesville, GA). Its FAQ says its own W2 crews install in Tennessee and serve Nashville regularly, but it has no local base; it is worth adding if regional installers are accepted. Also skipped Prestige Distribution (national network), Martin Bros (California), Widener Inc (PA), Division10 Inc (NY/NJ) and Demar Specialties (CA/NV).
Yelp: not tried (blocked in earlier runs).

candidates.name: Soran Group Inc
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage lists 'Bathroom Partitions & Hardware Installation' for commercial or residential spaces; contact form has a 'Bathroom Partitions Installation' option and the FAQ covers partition installation in the greater Nashville area.
red_flags: No project photos or named past partition jobs on the pages read
Also does residential doors and locksmith work, so it's a general door and hardware installer rather than a Division 10 specialist
Not seen supplying partitions, but confirm
candidates.reason: Nashville installer that names bathroom partition installation as a service and covers commercial doors too. Best fit on the list, but no project evidence was seen.

license.name: Soran Group Inc
license.registry: Tennessee Board for Licensing Contractors, Verify a License (verify.tn.gov, redirects to search.cloud.commerce.tn.gov)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. The state portal is a script-rendered search that uses reCAPTCHA, so it could not be searched automatically. Look this business up by hand there. The company site (https://sorangroupinc.com/) says only 'Licensed & Certified', with no license number or state named. Its header says 'Door Tech Nashville', which may be a trade name, so search both names. The site gives the base city as Nashville, TN and the phone as 615 949 9059. Metro Nashville also requires a permit bond and a Metro business license, but no public online contractor list was found for that.

candidates.name: Commercial Installation, LLC
candidates.partition_evidence: Building specialties installation includes 'restroom partitions'; the FAQ names toilet partitions. Shows supplier logos including Bobrick.
red_flags: Based in Clarksville, about 40+ miles from the area center (beyond the 30-mile limit)
Says it serves Middle Tennessee and Southern Kentucky but doesn't name Nashville
candidates.reason: Commercial installer that clearly installs toilet partitions. It's just outside the 30-mile radius but serves Middle Tennessee, so it's worth confirming Nashville coverage.

candidates.name: Allegheny Construction Specialties
candidates.partition_evidence: Division 10/11/12 contractor; the products page says it can provide every type of partition from every US manufacturer and that it supplies and installs toilet and bath accessories. Partition installation isn't stated outright.
red_flags: Supplies partitions itself (buy-around risk)
Offices also in Pittsburgh and South Florida; featured projects are casinos and hotels (larger GC work)
candidates.reason: Nashville-headquartered Division 10 furnish-and-install contractor. It likely installs partitions but also sells them, so it competes with us on supply.
